title: Optical Spectrum Analyzer
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC RSA.W6QK ACC-RSA
description_text: The U.S. Army Contracting Command-Redstone, Operations, Services, & Training Division, plans to obtain information to serve as market research to help identify potential sources that can provide a brand name purchase of one (1) Optical Spectrum Analyzer High Performance model or equivalent that will be a suitable replacement for an aging equipment. This item shall be delivered to the Army Primary Standards Laboratory (APSL), Building 5435 Fowler Road, Redstone Arsenal, AL. The Optical Spectrum Analyzer shall include the following specifications or equivalent (if not brand name): Yokogawa AQ6370E-20 Optical Spectrum Analyzer High Qty:1 Performance Model Wavelength range?600 to 1700 nm Wavelength accuracy?±0.01 nm Wavelength resolution?0.02 nm Close-in Dynamic range?78 dB typ. Level range?+20 to -90 dBm Up to 2x faster measurement: SMSR mode Sharper spectrum measurement: HCDR mode Large touchscreen LCD This RFI will utilize NAICS Code 334515
